dedupe_keys.name: winds and temperature observations from munch mast in bjørvika oslo norway

description: University of Oslo researchers publish raw wind and temperature observations from the Munch mast in Bjørvika, Oslo. The May 2018 Zenodo archive is free under CC BY 4.0. Public documentation maps six temperature sensors from two to seventy-five metres and wind sensors at ten, thirty and seventy-five metres. Wind variables include speed, direction, air temperature, zonal and meridional components and maximum gust since the previous interrogation. Filenames encode hour and date. These height-dependent observations can calibrate urban wind, thermal and building-exposure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this mast. The provider explicitly marks the seventy-five-metre wind sensor as wrong and says it should be removed. Raw temperature values require the supplied height-specific linear corrections, applied by subtraction. The actual observation span, within-hour sampling interval, reference time zone and measurement uncertainty remain unknown. The example filename is not evidence of complete March 2018 coverage. No raw observations were downloaded.
